description:
Long-Range Power for Everyday Commuting
With an efficient 250W brushless motor, 55Nm of torque and a 36V 15.6Ah (561.6Wh) removable battery, the BK6S L1 is built to make daily riding feel easier and more dependable. It delivers up to 70–150 km of range per charge, giving riders stronger range confidence for commuting, city journeys and longer weekend rides. Actual range depends on rider weight, terrain, temperature and assist mode.
Folding Design That Fits Real City Life
The BK6S L1 is designed to make e-bike ownership easier in everyday life. Its folding aluminium alloy frame is durable, corrosion-resistant and far more convenient to store when space is limited. It fits more neatly into a flat, office corner, hallway or car boot, making it a practical choice for commuters and urban riders who want electric support without the hassle of a full-size bike taking over their space.
More Comfort and Confidence on Rougher Roads
City streets are not always smooth, which is why the BK6S L1 is equipped with a front suspension fork with lockout, 20×3.0 puncture-resistant tyres and Shimano 7-speed gearing. Together, they help create a ride that feels more cushioned, more stable and less tiring on broken tarmac, kerbs and towpaths. Mechanical disc brakes and STVZO-certified front and rear lights, including a high-brightness brake light, add dependable control and visibility for day and night riding.
Practical Equipment for Everyday Use
Built for more than just the ride to work, the BK6S L1 comes with a front cargo rack and a rear rack with detachable seat cushion, giving you the flexibility to carry daily essentials or adapt the setup to suit different journeys. From commuting and grocery runs to carrying bags and accessories, it is designed to fit real routines. The removable battery also makes charging simpler and more convenient at home or in the office.
Smart Features That Keep Riding Simple
The BK6S L1 combines useful technology with an easy everyday riding experience. The S869 full-colour LCD display shows speed, mileage and battery status clearly at a glance, while the HITWAY App with Bluetooth adds ride tracking, diagnostics and performance monitoring. With IP54 water resistance, the bike is better prepared for day-to-day riding in mixed conditions, helping it stay practical, reliable and easy to live with through the week.
